newsitem.title: USA: Collins says strike cost about $1.5 mln/week.
newsitem.headline: Collins says strike cost about $1.5 mln/week.

text.p: Collins & Aikman Corp said Friday the strikes at General Motors Corp and Chrysler Corp are costing the company about $1.5 million a week in revenues.
But the company said the strikes did not affect its first quarter, which ended March 29. The GM strike has lasted 20 days and the Chrysler strike has lasted 15 days.
"We are keeping a close eye on this situation and will make any necessary adjustments if the strikes continue for an extended period," said chief executive officer Thomas Hannah.
Collins reported net income for the first quarter of $97 million compared to income of $136 million for the same period a year ago.
The company's operating income for the quarter was $41 million compared to operating income of $22 million for the same period a year ago.
The company said the increase in operating income was from acquisitions made in the end of 1997.
Collins & Aikman is an automotive interior systems supplier.
